FN-6YSP93Z-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 302
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Commissions
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/03/2026
House Bill 302 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Professional Bail
Bonding Board by an estimated $703 per meeting of the board by adding two additional
members to the board.
In addition, this bill codifies existing practice for late fees for certain licenses and establishes a
renewal fee for an inactive license of $100 and a late fee of $100 for failure to renew an inactive
license
Finally this bill could increase the administrative obligations of certain circuit clerks to submit
the list of authorized bail bond companies to the Board pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

House Bill 302
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/11/2026
House Bill 302 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary would increase the obligations of the
Alabama Professional Bail Bonding Board by an estimated $703 per meeting of the board by
adding two additional members to the board.
In addition, this bill codifies existing practice for collection of late fees for certain licenses and
establishes a renewal fee for an inactive license of $100 and a late fee of $100 for failure to
renew an inactive license.
Finally this bill could increase the administrative obligations of certain circuit clerks to submit
